entries.8f86d81b5150eb95: This business provides system monitoring and operation and services for IoT, centered on technology (A&A) that automatically detects and controls servers and IoT devices connected to the internet. It is a single segment, and sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥3,625 million. There are 3 consolidated subsidiaries: Mobicomm Inc., JIG-SAW US, INC. and JIG-SAW CA, INC. The equity-method affiliate is SBI JIG-SAW Modernizations Co., Ltd. (49% of voting rights held), a joint venture for the financial industry. This is the only business for which sales are disclosed independently, and no breakdown amounts are disclosed.

entries.c1a9b72b00b4237f: This service uses the in-house developed robot-type automated operations platform "puzzle" to automatically monitor and operate physical servers, cloud servers, IoT devices and network equipment. It is provided 24 hours a day, 365 days a year from 2 sites in Sapporo and a control center in Toronto, North America. This is a category for which amounts are not disclosed independently.
